in_sanskrit.name: ध्रुवकृष्ण
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: A name of Lord Krishna, meaning the eternal, unchanging aspect of the deity.

in_hindi.name: ध्रुवकृष्ण
in_hindi.long_meaning: नाम श्रीकृष्ण के लिए है, जो अविनाशी और अचल पहचान का अर्थ है।

in_telugu.name: ధ్రువకృష్ణ
in_telugu.long_meaning: కృష్ణకు ఒక పేరు, అతి స్థిరంగా ఉంది.

in_marathi.name: Dhruvkrish
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Star of Dharma
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dhruvkrish हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dhruvkrish, derived from Dhruva and Krishna, symbolizes the unwavering devotion and dharma of Lord Krishna.

in_bengali.name: Dhruvkrish
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Star of Dharma
in_bengali.long_meaning: Dhruvkrish একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Dhruvkrish, derived from Dhruva and Krishna, symbolizes the unwavering devotion and dharma of Lord Krishna.
